title: Manuel
creator: CrossFit
description: Five 10-minute rounds on a running clock: 3 minutes of rope climbs, 2 of squats, 2 of push-ups, then a 400 m run inside a 3-minute window, resting whatever is left. Honours Italian Army Capt. Manuel Fiorito, killed by a roadside bomb in Kabul in 2006. Score is total reps; wear a vest if you have one.

source.title: Manuel – CrossFit Hero WOD

items.name: 5 rounds (10 min each)
items.note: Score total reps. Wear a 20/14 lb (9/6.5 kg) weight vest or body armour if you have one.

steps.note: 3-minute window; rest the remainder before the next round
